nodes.description: MICU1 normally sets a cytosolic calcium threshold below which the uniporter stays closed and cooperatively boosts uptake once calcium rises. Its loss makes uptake inappropriately active at resting and low cytosolic calcium, while blunting the rise in uptake during large cytosolic calcium transients. Cytosolic calcium signals are correspondingly reduced in patient cells.
